results.text: Effect of diphenylhydantoin and lithium on whole brain serotonin, sodium and potassium in mice. The effect of lithium and Diphenylhydantoin separately and in combination on whole brain serotonin, sodium and potassium were studied in mice. 9 day treatment with lithium was found to significantly raise brain serotonin. Comparison of Cardiovascular Outcomes Between Chlorthalidone and Hydrochlorothiazide in Hypertensive Patients. Chlorthalidone (CLTD) and hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ) are widely used thiazide diuretics for hypertension management. This study aimed to evaluate and compare the cardiovascular outcomes of patients treated with CLTD versus HCTZ.
